name: Antonio Sausys
reason: Health restore re-check, 13 Nov 2026 (yogaforgriefrelief.com home, bio, services, training, products and contact pages; robots.txt allows us): grief work is wellbeing under the new rule, but his own pages still present Yoga for Grief Relief as 'a somatic psychotherapeutic process' and himself as a somatic psychologist specialising in grief counselling and therapy. Item by item: individual and Skype sessions are grief counselling with intake forms, 'treatment goals' and a move into personal therapy (therapy, out); the group series is described as grief counselling in a group (therapy, out); the Professional Training is for health and mental-health professionals with CEUs and teaches differential diagnosis and grief treatment guidelines (clinician training, out), with its retreat on 6-8 Nov 2026 and modules 'TBA Spring 2026' (dated/stale); the next listed retreat (7-9 Nov 2025) has passed; the Yoga for Energy Flow DVD is sold as opposing 'degeneration and disease' (health claim, out); his book is out of print with no ISBN on his site. What remains is his YogiViews channel (562 subscribers, Data API 13 Nov 2026), mostly short trailers of interviews with other teachers, and his site has no photo of him. Too thin once therapy is left out. Email antonio@yogaforgriefrelief.com; office San Anselmo, California (contact page).
